title: Operationalize continuous model landscape tracker and procurement triggers
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem / opportunity: We lack a low-friction, operational signal-to-procurement pipeline that converts model telemetry, market signals, and customer feedback into ranked procurement and fallback recommendations. PMs and SREs manually reconcile spreadsheets and ad-hoc notes; sales and partnerships receive delayed, noisy intelligence.

Goal: Build and ship a continuous, opinionated 'decision bridge' that fuses model availability/latency/cost telemetry with external market indicators and buyer interviews to produce: (1) a living ranked inventory of candidate model fallbacks, (2) procurement trigger alerts when risk thresholds cross, and (3) a weekly digest for sales/solutions with recommended next actions.

Deliverables:
- Ingest pipeline spec tying telemetry (latency percentiles, error rates, availability) + market indicators (provider outage feeds, license changes, pricing shifts) + qualitative signals (customer interviews, field reports).
- A scoring rubric (Procurement Readiness Score) and ruleset for triggers with tunable thresholds.
- Grafana/Looker dashboard + a lightweight API endpoint for programmatic access.
- Weekly digest template (email/Notion) and an internal playbook for follow-ups.
- On-call runbook for high-severity model supply incidents.

Out of scope: Full procurement automation (legal/contract execution) and long-term vendor negotiations. This ticket focuses on signal fusion, scoring, and operational alerts.

Success metrics (first 90 days):
- Time from signal -> recommended action reduced to < 8 hours for P1 procurement signals.
- Weekly digest adopted by 3 sales/solutions leads and used in at least 2 renewal conversations per month.
- False positive rate for procurement triggers < 15% after first calibration sweep.
steps: Define ingestion schema and required telemetry fields (latency p50/p95/p99, errors, capacity anomalies)
Map external signal sources and agree on ingestion cadence (market feed, provider status pages, procurement feeds)
Prototype Procurement Readiness Score and threshold buckets (green/yellow/red)
Implement dashboard mock in Grafana and prototype digest template in Notion
Build lightweight API endpoint (read-only) for programmatic access to ranked inventory
Integrate alerting into Slack #model-sentinel and email digest pipeline
Run calibration pilot with two enterprise accounts and gather feedback
Document playbook/runbook and hand off to SRE and Account Ops
acceptance_criteria: 1) Data pipeline ingests telemetry and at least two external market signals at 15-minute cadence; 2) Procurement Readiness Score computed for active models and exposed via API; 3) Dashboard surfaces top-10 at-risk models with drilldowns; 4) Alerting fires to Slack and creates a Tracker ticket when red-threshold crossed; 5) Weekly digest sent for two weeks and receives at least one actionable reply from sales/solutions.
